analogy.rationale: The annotated targets (BST1, LDHA, PARP1, SIRT5) are not canonical protein synthesis machinery, and no reference class directly stimulates translation; the closest opposing or pathway-adjacent classes are protein synthesis inhibitors and mTOR/PI3K/AKT inhibitors, which would not mimic a stimulant response, so little to no transcriptional response is expected.
